# systemd --user units enabled on this machine.
#
# These are NOT stowed. ~/.config/systemd/user/*.target.wants/ contains only
# symlinks into /usr/lib/systemd/user/, generated by `systemctl --user enable`.
# Stowing a symlink farm of symlinks is fragile and breaks when a package moves
# its unit file, so the enabled set is recorded here instead.
#
# Re-enable on a fresh machine:
#   grep -v '^#' meta/systemd-user-units.txt | xargs -r systemctl --user enable --now

warp-taskbar.service
arch-update-tray.service
arch-update.timer
docker.socket
